meta.orientation: a/b as in the first snapshot that listed the bout (cards_upcoming.json order); p_* = probability that A wins; captures taken with a/b swapped are flipped
meta.market_open: fightodds.io per-book opening lines (sportsbooks only), Shin no-vig, logit-mean (latest read; market_open_first_read keeps the first)
meta.first_capture: first pre-start snapshot that had lines for the bout
meta.last_pre_lock: last snapshot before the event lock (earliest start_utc of the card): the market at prediction time, comparable with a prediction file committed before the lock
meta.last_pre_start: last snapshot before the bout started: the closing-line proxy (hours_before_start says how close to the bell it was)
meta.archived_close: first snapshot after the bout's start: the books' archived closing lines as BFO/fightodds keep them (exchanges may be in-play/settled; p_consensus, p_meandec_mult and bfo_p_a_novig exclude exchanges)
meta.bfo_p_a_novig: mean of BestFightOdds' sportsbook lines, multiplicative no-vig: the ledger's closing benchmark (data/predictions/README.md)
meta.use: forward-test benchmark; never a training feature for 2026 fights
